scope: Gameplay-only planning estimate; not overall beta completion or test pass rate

Add production 20/10/10 staged selection with saved/default choices, lock boundaries, real timer checks and four-peer ballot outcomes. Existing ten-perk/effect/save/isolation checks pass. Character preselection, reveal animation, human balance and authenticated reconnect remain unfinished.

target_status: Reached as a provisional gameplay planning milestone; overall beta release readiness remains unmeasured
assessment_note: Six planning points above VS28: arsenal +2, co-op/recovery +3, staged progression +1. Controls and arena scores are retained. No production-art, finished-arena, Internet, performance, human-fun or package-full-run credit is inferred from controlled fixtures.
